description: This Java class defines a data container for handling file upload requests in a web service, encapsulating input streams, file metadata, request details, and locale/date format settings.

classes.name: UploadRequest
classes.description: A data transfer object for handling file upload form data, including file streams, metadata, and locale information.

methods.name: getUploadedInputStream
methods.description: Returns the InputStream representing the uploaded file content.

methods.name: setUploadedInputStream
methods.description: Sets the InputStream for the uploaded file content.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale string associated with the upload request.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale string for the upload request.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the date format string associated with the upload request.

methods.name: setDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the date format string for the upload request.
